responsibility: Implements the current LLVM/Clang-style AVR frontend calling convention by converting aggregate arguments and returns to indirect passing while leaving non-aggregates unchanged.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/avr.rs`, this AVR file is only the frontend calling-convention adjustment layer, making aggregates indirect for calls; it does not describe the inline-assembly register names, pair/pointer aliases, modifiers, or overlap relations.
